full_name: Dual Visual Encoder for Unified Autoregressive Multimodal Learning

understanding_encoder.purpose: Extract high-level semantic features for understanding tasks

generation_encoder.purpose: Convert images to discrete tokens for autoregressive generation

training_stages.name: Encoder Pre-training
training_stages.description: Pre-train understanding encoder (SigLIP) and generation encoder (VQ-GAN) separately

training_stages.name: Alignment Training
training_stages.description: Train projectors to align visual features with LLM embedding space

training_stages.name: Joint Fine-tuning
training_stages.description: End-to-end training on mixed understanding and generation tasks
training_stages.data: Mixed dataset: VQA + captioning + image generation (10M samples)

training_stages.name: Instruction Tuning
training_stages.description: SFT on instruction-following data for both modalities
